SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS PO_LINE_ID, COUNT(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HIJI' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(END_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(QUOTATION_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(QUOTATION_SEQ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RD_DATE, ' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(PO_LINE_ID), 0) AS REF_IF_NO, LAST_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS AS REQ_USER_MAIL, OFFICE_PHONE, MOBILE_PHONE, OFFICE_PHONE||' '||MOBILE_PHONE AS REQ_USER_TEL, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM APPS.KEPRFQ, XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = PO_LINE_ID AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*' ORDER BY QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RFQ' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_LINE_ID$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
